q01:
WITH revenue_by_region AS (
    SELECT
        r.name AS region,
        SUM(ol.amount_cents * ol.qty) AS revenue_cents
    FROM
        orders od
    JOIN
        order_lines ol ON od.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN
        customers c ON od.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN
        regions r ON c.region_id = r.region_id
    LEFT JOIN
        refunds rf ON od.order_id = rf.order_id
    WHERE
        od.status <> 'cancelled'
        AND od.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND od.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
    GROUP BY
        r.name
),
net_revenue_by_region AS (
    SELECT
        rr.region,
        SUM(rr.revenue_cents) - SUM(rf.amount_cents) AS revenue_cents
    FROM
        revenue_by_region rr
    LEFT JOIN
        refunds rf ON rr.region = (SELECT r.name FROM regions r JOIN orders o ON r.region_id = o.region_id WHERE o.order_id = rf.order_id)
    GROUP BY
        rr.region
)
SELECT
    region,
    revenue_cents
FROM
    net_revenue_by_region
WHERE
    revenue_cents > 0
q02:
WITH net_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        ol.order_id,
        SUM(ol.amount_cents) AS order_total,
        SUM(r.amount_cents) AS refunds_total
    FROM
        order_lines ol
    LEFT JOIN
        refunds r ON ol.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE
        ol.order_id IN (
            SELECT
                order_id
            FROM
                orders
            WHERE
                status <> 'cancelled'
                AND deleted_at IS NULL
                AND strftime('%Y-%m-%d', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-08-01'
        )
    GROUP BY
        ol.order_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(order_total - COALESCE(refunds_total, 0)) AS revenue_cents
FROM
    net_revenue

q05:
WITH order_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        SUM(ol.qty * ol.amount_cents) AS revenue_cents
    FROM
        orders od
    JOIN
        order_lines ol ON od.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN
        products p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN
        refunds r ON od.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE
        od.ordered_at >= '2026-05-01'
        AND od.ordered_at < '2026-08-01'
        AND od.status <> 'cancelled'
        AND od.deleted_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY
        p.category
),
refund_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        SUM(r.amount_cents) AS refund_cents
    FROM
        refunds r
    JOIN
        orders od ON r.order_id = od.order_id
    JOIN
        order_lines ol ON od.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN
        products p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE
        r.refunded_at >= '2026-05-01'
        AND r.refunded_at < '2026-08-01'
        AND od.status <> 'cancelled'
        AND od.deleted_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY
        p.category
)
SELECT
    o.category,
    (o.revenue_cents - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0)) AS revenue_cents
FROM
    order_revenue o
LEFT JOIN
    refund_revenue r ON o.category = r.category
GROUP BY
    o.category
ORDER BY
    revenue_cents DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH filtered_orders AS (
    SELECT
        od.order_id,
        cu.region_id,
        ol.amount_cents,
        rf.amount_cents AS refund_cents
    FROM orders od
    JOIN customers cu ON od.customer_id = cu.customer_id
    JOIN order_lines ol ON od.order_id = ol.order_id
    LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON od.order_id = rf.order_id
    WHERE od.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND od.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND od.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-08-01'
    AND ol.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM products WHERE category ='services')
),
region_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        re.name AS region,
        SUM(ol.amount_cents - COALESCE(rf.amount_cents, 0)) AS services_revenue_cents
    FROM filtered_orders fo
    JOIN regions re ON fo.region_id = re.region_id
    GROUP BY re.name
)
SELECT
    region,
    services_revenue_cents
FROM region_revenue
ORDER BY services_revenue_cents DESC

    SELECT
        c.region_id,
        SUM(ol.amount_cents) AS total_revenue,
        SUM(r.amount_cents) AS total_refunds
    FROM
        orders od
    JOIN
        order_lines ol ON od.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN
        products p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN
        customers c ON od.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN
        refunds r ON od.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE
        od.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-08-01'
        AND od.status <> 'cancelled'
        AND od.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND c.region_id IN (SELECT region_id FROM regions WHERE name = 'APAC')
    GROUP BY
        c.region_id
)

    r.name AS region,
    COALESCE(SUM(rd.total_revenue - rd.total_refunds), 0) AS net_revenue_cents
FROM
    regions r
LEFT JOIN
    revenue_data rd ON r.region_id = rd.region_id
WHERE
    r.name = 'APAC'
GROUP BY
    r.name

WITH order_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        ol.order_id,
        SUM(ol.amount_cents) AS order_total,
        SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -r.amount_cents ELSE 0 END) AS refund_total
    FROM order_lines ol
    LEFT JOIN refunds r ON ol.order_id = r.order_id
    GROUP BY ol.order_id
),
filtered_orders AS (
    SELECT
        oo.order_id,
        oo.customer_id,
        (oo.order_total + oo.refund_total) AS net_revenue
    FROM orders oo
    JOIN order_revenue orr ON oo.order_id = orr.order_id
    WHERE oo.status <> 'cancelled'
        AND oo.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND oo.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-08-01'
),
customer_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        fo.customer_id,
        SUM(fo.net_revenue) AS total_revenue_cents
    FROM filtered_orders fo
    GROUP BY fo.customer_id
)
SELECT
    c.name AS customer,
    cr.total_revenue_cents AS revenue_cents
FROM customer_revenue cr
JOIN customers c ON cr.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY cr.total_revenue_cents DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH revenue_by_quarter AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', od.ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-05' AND '2026-07' THEN 'FQ2'
            WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', od.ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08' AND '2026-10' THEN 'FQ3'
        END AS fiscal_quarter,
        SUM(ol.amount_cents) - COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_cents), 0) AS revenue_cents
    FROM orders od
    LEFT JOIN order_lines ol ON od.order_id = ol.order_id
    LEFT JOIN refunds r ON od.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE od.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND od.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND od.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-10-31'
    GROUP BY fiscal_quarter
)
SELECT * FROM revenue_by_quarter

    regions re ON ru.region_id = re.region_id

WITH order_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y-%m', od.ordered_at) AS month,
        SUM(ol.amount_cents) AS revenue_cents
    FROM orders od
    JOIN order_lines ol ON od.order_id = ol.order_id
    LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON od.order_id = rf.order_id
    WHERE od.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-08-01'
        AND od.status <> 'cancelled'
        AND od.deleted_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY month
),
order_refunds AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y-%m', rf.refunded_at) AS month,
        SUM(rf.amount_cents) AS refund_cents
    FROM refunds rf
    JOIN orders od ON rf.order_id = od.order_id
    WHERE rf.refunded_at BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-08-01'
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT
    o.month,
    COALESCE(o.revenue_cents, 0) - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM order_revenue o
FULL OUTER JOIN order_refunds r ON o.month = r.month
WHERE COALESCE(o.revenue_cents, 0) - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) > 0
ORDER BY o.month
